name: Franklin city, VA
findings: Franklin city has 48 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Franklin city list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
